newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine first half farm output grew 3.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine first half farm output grew 3.43 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' agriculture sector grew 3.43 percent in the first six months of the year, the Department of Agriculture said on Tuesday.
The figure was below the 4.75 percent growth in the first half of 1996.
The farm sector accounts for about 21 percent of total domestic output.
The government said the sector's gross output in the first half was valued at 122.7 billion pesos at constant prices.
Major crops, which contribute 39.9 percent of the total output, grew at a slower pace of 2.4 percent compared with 7.54 percent last year. These include unmilled rice, corn and coconut.
The poultry segment recorded a 10.25 percent increase in the first six months, barely changed from last year's 10.24 percent.
Livestock increased by 5.42 percent from 5.97 percent, while the fishery subsector recovered with a growth of 0.64 percent in the first half from last year's 0.98 percent decline.
On average, farmgate price prices rose by 1.28 percent in the first half, the agriculture department said.
